testcase.name: encoded UTF-16 character cap is checked before parsing including whitespace
null and absent nullable timing fields encode to the same representation
zone must be a named IANA identifier or UTC not a raw offset
text escapes unicode and exact integer boundary values round trip
identifiers must use canonical lowercase UUID shape
duplicate schedule identifiers fail encoding and decoding
unknown missing and wrong-type record fields fail the whole set
empty set and default models are explicit and do not imply an error
missing extra duplicate unknown and wrong-type weekdays fail
one hundred schedules is the inclusive record cap
blank and oversized mode references are rejected without replacing unknown ones
invalid and mixed timing shapes are not normalized into valid schedules
revision and time numbers are never coerced from strings fractions or overflow
malformed roots unsupported schema and trailing documents fail
weekday set order is canonical and unknown mode references remain unchanged
one-time and repeating enabled states round trip without adding occurrences
names must be trimmed nonempty and within eighty UTF-16 characters
